reviews.text:
They have everything for pets, a great selection of food, and if they don't have it, they'll get it for you very quickly.
The service is excellent, and they also offer grooming services.
Very competitive prices.

If you have advertised on your website and on the door of your establishment that you close at 9:00 PM on weekdays, you could comply, because with this unbearable heat, making the journey to your store and finding it closed is not very pleasant.

I booked an appointment here because the website said they groom dogs, cats, and exotic animals. However, when I arrived, they told me they don't groom cats or exotic animals, so the information is confusing and should be updated.

Also, I arrived with a reservation, had to find parking, and walk about ten minutes to the center, so I would have appreciated knowing this beforehand.

On the positive side, Alex seemed passionate about animals, eager to do things well, learn, and improve. He was attentive and knowledgeable. He even offered to walk me to the parking lot to help with my cat, which I appreciated.

In short: they should clarify the services they offer, but Alex's service was good.
Excellent service. Fantastic! Impeccable bath and haircut. We'll be back.
Even halfway through the collection process for the renovation, they treated me with kindness and even managed to resolve my problem themselves. Thank you very much.
Very friendly helpful staff and they had the raw food I wanted for my dog.
I was looking for bedding for a guinea pig. The staff were very helpful and eager to assist me. Unfortunately, I couldn't buy it because they didn't have any similar products.
Charming; always at the service of furry friends and their companions, with especially affordable prices :-)
Excellent service, great selection of pet supplies
Good prices, good service.
Excellent! You can find everything for your pets, and the staff is so friendly and welcoming that it makes you feel great. Definitely 10/10.
They were helpful and I found the toy I wanted for my cat. Very welcoming and kind staff.
Great variety! I highly recommend this place 👏 The staff is very friendly and professional 😊 I'll definitely shop with you again 🐈‍⬛🐕🦜🐹🐰 …
The best place to buy pet supplies 🥰🥹💚 The owners are so sweet and have definitely left a mark 🐾 on our hearts. Thank you, Ricardo …
I needed to place an order with Glovo urgently. The staff at this store were incredibly helpful and provided solutions. I'm very grateful for their service.
Great service!!!

A 10 out of 10! I moved to this neighborhood a year ago, and since then they've become my go-to shop for anything my dog ​​needs. You can tell they love animals and are always incredibly attentive to their owners. They're wonderful. Highly recommended!

Ricardo is amazing! Helpful, kind, generous, and with a great love for animals. The shop is beautiful and has a great variety of products for our pets. The service couldn't be better. 100% RECOMMENDED
The photos are outdated.
I love this shop. They have everything and the advice is fantastic. You can tell how much they love animals. It's wonderful! My favorite shop!
Everything was very nice and the recommendations were good.
Fantastic pet shop. We go every day for a snack; my daughter is happy and they treat her like the princess she is. Highly recommended.

It's a fabulous store!!! They have everything I could possibly need for my dog! They have an excellent selection of products designed for pet well-being: dry food, wet food, toys, walking accessories, beds… all of the highest quality, with the best ingredients and materials!

And Ricardo and Andrea's service is top-notch!
I went to get food for my kitten, who was recently spayed. The advice was perfect and the girl who helped me was super friendly ♥️
